# First days of the months of Muhammadiyah's Kalender Hijriah Global
# Tunggal (KHGT), 1447-1492 AH, as its calendar page shows them.
#
# Read 2026-09-27 from https://khgt.muhammadiyah.or.id/kalendar-hijriah,
# one page per year (?year=1447 to ?year=1492), each month's first cell
# giving the Gregorian day of its 1st (khgt-kalendar-hijriah). Columns:
# Hijri year, month, and the Gregorian year, month and day of the 1st.
#
# One row the page gives is left out: it heads Dhu al-Hijja 1492 with
# "Januari 1970", which is no date of that month; the month's first day
# is therefore not carried.
